title: EpisodeBrief
description: The seed spec for one episode. Created by the CLI at episode init time; consumed by Agent A.

episode_id.description: Unique slug for the episode folder, e.g. ForeignCarsTH_cadillac-cimarron

channel_id.description: Identifier of the channel this episode belongs to, e.g. ForeignCarsTH

language.description: BCP-47-ish language code or name for narration, e.g. th, en

topic.description: The subject of the episode, e.g. Cadillac Cimarron

quirk.description: The specific angle/hook that makes this episode interesting

target_audience.description: Who this episode is made for, e.g. car enthusiasts, general audience
